people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?
translations.bsb: “Have you spared all the women?” he asked them.
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
